label: WA vehicle sales/use tax exemption reinstated
detail: Historical exemption for qualifying clean alternative-fuel and certain plug-in hybrid vehicles; price and eligibility conditions applied. This was an exemption of taxable value rather than a cash rebate.

label: WA new-vehicle exempt taxable value stepped down
detail: Historical qualifying new-vehicle exemption covered up to 20000 USD of sales or lease price for transactions from 2021-08-01 through 2023-07-31; eligibility and price caps applied.

label: WA new-vehicle exempt taxable value stepped down again
detail: Historical qualifying new-vehicle exemption covered up to 15000 USD of sales or lease price for transactions from 2023-08-01 through 2025-07-31; eligibility and price caps applied.

label: WA EV-ready building-rule amendment effective
detail: WAC 51-50-0429 applies to new buildings and accessory structures with occupancy-specific charging/EV-ready/EV-capable provisions and exceptions. This date is the current rule's listed amendment effective date; it is not evidence of causal station additions.

label: Last day of WA purchase sales/use tax exemption
detail: Exemption for new purchases expired after this date. Separately qualifying leases entered by the cutoff may retain an exemption on payments through 2028-07-31; do not treat this as a current new-purchase benefit.

label: Last acquisition day for federal clean-vehicle credits
detail: Sections 30D/25E/45W unavailable for vehicles acquired after this date. Later placement in service may qualify if a binding contract and payment established acquisition by the cutoff; other eligibility rules remain applicable.
